text: How do you stop a team when solving one problem creates another? Double up on Lamine Yamal, and someone else gets the space. Follow Raphinha, and the next runner goes beyond you. Try to take a breath, and Barcelona are already coming again. Seven competitive games. Seven wins. Thirty-three goals. That is the start Hansi Flick's team have made to this season. But the scorelines are only half the warning. The really interesting part is how many different ways this Barcelona side can hurt you. And there is one match that explains both why Europe should be worried, and why nobody should hand them a trophy yet. Because this team is dangerous. More dangerous than you think. But first, look at what happens before their opponents have even settled.
